Unsafe invariants: added unsafe blocks are windows-rs COM/Win32 calls on interfaces owned by the live DirectX/DirectWrite state, called on the thread that owns that state, with HRESULTs and out-parameters checked before use. Raw memory outside embedded debug shader compilation is touched in three places only: the frame-capture readback copies w*4 bytes per row of a w x h BGRA8 staging texture between Map and Unmap (RowPitch >= w*4), GPU timing reads a query result through the raw GetData vtable entry into a plain-data out-value whose size is passed with it, and external-texture registration adopts a non-null ID3D11Texture2D pointer already AddRef'd by the caller (from_raw takes that reference). Release builds never select the debug-only WARP/D3D11On12 device overrides.
